Components/Overlays

Command palette

Search and run actions from the keyboard (Mantine's Spotlight): fuzzy search, groups, shortcuts, ⌘K / Ctrl+K; combobox + listbox pattern in a modal dialog.

Open command palette

On this site ⌘K belongs to the docs search in the header — another ray-command-palette, over the components and guides. This one has hotkey="" and opens with the button.

API

<ray-command-palette> · RayCommandPalette

Running an action fires ray-select and calls its onSelect. The best matches come first, grouped.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
openopen reflectsbooleanShown.
actions—arrayThe actions.
queryquerystringThe search text.
placeholderplaceholderstringSearch commands…Placeholder of the search field.
hotkeyhotkeystringmod+kToggle shortcut (mod = ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere); empty to disable.
limitlimitnumber50Maximum results.
emptyLabelempty-labelstringNothing foundText without results.
labellabelstringCommand paletteAccessible name.
hideHinthide-hint reflectsbooleanNo keyboard hint at the bottom.
overlayBluroverlay-blurstringBlur of the page behind: px ("8"), a CSS length or "none". Default: --ray-overlay-blur ([overlay] blur in tokens.toml).
EventDescription
ray-selectAn action was run.
ray-openAfter it opened.
ray-closeAfter it closed.
PartDescription
dialogThe dialog.
inputThe search field.
optionEach result.
